newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares inch higher ahead of U.S. poll.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares inch higher ahead of U.S. poll.

text.p: Austrian shares inched higher in a mixed session on Monday, with the main focus on Tuesday's U.S. elections, traders said.
"I don't think we'll see much activity in Europe ahead of the elections," said one. Most market participants see the underlying mood remaining positive in the short term.
Trading was suspended for 40 minutes shortly after opening due to a technical problem with the bourse's newly installed EQOS electronic trading system. The session was extended by one hour.
The ATX blue chip index edged up 3.08 or 0.29 percent to 1,070.15. Among its constituents eight shares rose and 13 fell.
Engineering group VA Technologie was the leading gainer, up 39.8 schillings at 1,529.8.
The leading decliner of the session was brick maker Wienerberger Baustoffindustrie, shedding 14.6 schillings at 1,958.0.

Preferred shares of Creditanstalt rose 3.4 schillings to 503.4 after Die Erste Oesterreichische SparCasse Bank AG said it was likely to rejoin an international consortium bidding for a stake in the bank, two months after quitting the group.
The November ATX future climbed 5.8 points to 1,069.5. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
